source: NCHS public-use death certificate files 1968-2004 as hosted by NBER (https://data.nber.org/mortality/), one record per death; counts per county, measure and place summed by pipeline/history.py (cache nber_counts_<year>.json)
what: Exact county counts of 1-9 that MortalGIS currently hides (shown as count -1) in the NBER series. Keys: measure -> place (res = county where the person lived, occ = county of death) -> year -> {county FIPS: count}. Every cell here is a cell the site hides today; nothing else is included.
note: STAGED ONLY. Not wired into any build. Whether the NCHS data-use rules allow showing counts under 10 for these files is unresolved (see sourcing plan, Round 4/5); the owner asked on 2026-10-09 that exact 1-9 counts be shown where allowable. 1989-2004 cells are counties of 100,000+ people only (the public files do not identify smaller ones). Rebuilt 2026-10-15 after the crosswalk fixes in pipeline/history.py (Georgia, Missouri, Nevada, New Mexico, South Dakota 1968-1981; Virginia cities 1968-1969; Alaska blank before 1982). 1972 is left out: its file is a 50% sample, so its counts are not exact.
